 It’s matchday! Here’s what you need to know as the U.S. Men’s National Team takes on Haiti at Nu Stadium in Miami at 4:30 p.m. ET November 14, 2026 🇺🇸 USA vs. Haiti 🇭🇹 
 Saturday, Nov. 14 | 4:30 p.m. ET 
 Nu Stadium | Miami, Fla. 
 Concacaf Nations League Quarterfinals, Leg 1 
 📺 Watch: TNT, truTV, HBO Max, Telemundo, Universo, Peacock
 🎧 Listen: Westwood One Sports / Fútbol de Primera
 🎟️ Tickets: Click Here

 Here is the current forecast for Miami on Saturday, according to Weather.com :
 Skies: Sunny
 Temperature: 72 degrees

 Humidity: 32%
 Wind: 9 mph N
 Three Things to Watch 
 1. A competitive test 
Saturday’s match marks the first official competition of the 2030 FIFA World Cup cycle. The four winners from the Quarterfinals will advance to the Finals in March at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, Calif.
 READ: Everything You Need to Know about USMNT’s Fall Camp 
 2. Aggregate score 
The Concacaf Nations League Quarterfinals feature an aggregate format, which means a two-legged setup with one match hosted by each nation. The second leg kicks off Tuesday, Nov. 17 at TQL Stadium in Cincinnati, Ohio and the goals from each of the two games are added together for an aggregate score.
 READ: The Last Meeting Between the U.S. and Haiti 
 3. Farewell to Pochettino 
These two Concacaf Nations League will be the final for Mauricio Pochettino as head coach of the U.S. Men’s National Team before he departs to become manager of Manchester United in the English Premier League.

 Nu Stadium in Miami, Fla. seats more than 26,000 and is home to Lionel Messi and Inter Miami CF in MLS. The USMNT is seeking its 10th victory in the Miami area.
